channel.title: DetectHiddenFees Automotive Guides
channel.description: New guides about car dealer fees and auto financing.

item.title: Dealer Add-On Cost Breakdown: Every Hidden Car Dealer Fee Explained
item.description: A line-by-line field guide to optional products, dealer charges, and the financing math that turns a “small” add-on into a large lifetime cost.

item.title: Hidden Auto Loan Fees That Increase Your True Interest Rate
item.description: How dealer-arranged financing changes the cost of a car—and how to compare APR, amount financed, term, and total of payments without getting lost in the monthly payment.

item.title: Hidden Car Dealer Fees Guide: What to Question Before You Pay
item.description: A practical map of dealer fees, taxes, registration, accessories, and questionable line items—built for the moment you receive an out-the-door quote.

item.title: Auto Loan Fine Print Explained: APR, Terms, Defaults, and More
item.description: Plain-English explanations of the clauses that govern your auto loan after you drive away, including payment allocation, insurance, default, and payoff language.

item.title: Vehicle Purchase Agreement Review Guide: How to Audit Every Line
item.description: A step-by-step review method for the buyer’s order, retail installment contract, trade-in paperwork, and addendum before you sign.

item.title: Dealer Documentation Fees Explained: What They Cover and How to Negotiate
item.description: Why doc fees vary, what a documentation charge can and cannot mean, where state rules matter, and how to compare dealers on total price.

item.title: Dealer Markup Explained: How a Rate Becomes More Expensive at the Dealership
item.description: Understand dealer-arranged APR markups, lender buy rates, compensation incentives, and the fair way to compare a preapproval with a dealer offer.

item.title: Extended Warranty Hidden Costs: Coverage, Exclusions, and Pricing Traps
item.description: What service contracts actually cover, how they are priced and financed, and the exclusions, deductibles, cancellation rules, and repair networks buyers miss.

item.title: GAP Insurance Cost Analysis: When It Helps and When It Is Overpriced
item.description: A clear framework for estimating the gap, comparing dealer and insurer pricing, and spotting a financed GAP product that lasts less time than your loan.

item.title: Car Purchase Contract Red Flags: 25 Clauses to Stop and Question
item.description: The blanks, mismatches, add-ons, conditional-delivery language, and arithmetic errors that deserve a pause before you sign a vehicle contract.

item.title: Spot Delivery Scam Guide: What to Do When Financing “Isn’t Final”
item.description: How yo-yo financing works, what conditional delivery language can signal, and the careful steps to take if a dealer calls you back for new terms.

item.title: Auto Financing Hidden Charges: The Complete Cost Map
item.description: A complete map of interest, fees, financed products, negative equity, taxes, and payment mechanics that can increase the amount you repay.

item.title: Car Buying Checklist Before Signing: Print This at the Dealership
item.description: The practical sequence for checking the car, price, trade, financing, optional products, contract math, and delivery documents before signing.

item.title: Hidden Dealer Charges by State: A National Overview for Car Buyers
item.description: How state rules, caps, taxes, title charges, advertising assessments, and dealer add-ons affect the out-the-door price across the United States.

item.title: Dealer Fee Negotiation Guide: Scripts, Math, and Leverage That Work
item.description: How to negotiate the total transaction—not just the payment—with scripts for doc fees, add-ons, APR, trade-ins, and last-minute charges.
